title: Variables & Collections
description: Store and share game data using Local and Global variables, ordered Lists, and key-value Maps. Manage values in the Variable Manager and bind them to nodes.

blocks.content: Variables store data that your game reads and updates at runtime, such as player health, score, inventory lists, or dialogue tables. You manage variables in the **Variables** panel on the left side of the [visual scripting](visual_scripting/graph_concepts) workspace.

items.title: Local & Global Scopes
items.desc: Keep data private to one script instance (**Local**) or share it across every scene (**Global**).

items.title: Lists & Maps
items.desc: Build nested arrays and key-value dictionaries visually or with the **Raw JSON Editor**.

items.title: Direct Port Binding
items.desc: Bind variables directly to node input ports and apply inline modifiers without extra nodes.

items.title: Inspector Overrides
items.desc: Tune **Local** primitive variables per entity in the [Script Controller](components/script_controller) inspector.

blocks.content: Every variable has a **Scope** that controls where it can be accessed and a **Type** that defines the kind of value it holds.

rows: Isolated to each entity running the script. Resets when the entity or scene unloads.
Yes (Number, String, and Boolean appear in Script Controller)
Movement speed, enemy patrol range, entity health, cooldown flags.
Shared across all scripts and scenes in the project for the entire game session.
Total score, collected coins, player inventory, audio settings, quest state.

blocks.content: Lupis Engine supports three primitive types and two structured collection types.

rows: Text values such as names, dialogue lines, tags, or asset IDs.
Numeric values for counters, timers, stats, and coordinates.
True or false flags for states and conditions.
Zero-indexed ordered list of items. Elements can be primitives or nested lists and maps.
Key-value dictionary accessed by string keys. Values can be primitives or nested collections.

blocks.message: Check the **Panel** checkbox on a variable row in the **Variable Manager** to expose that variable in the left **Variables** sidebar for quick editing and drag-and-drop.

blocks.content: Create and structure your variables in the **Variable Manager** modal, then drag or bind them into your node graph.

items: Open a script tab and click the **Manage Variables** sliders icon in the **Variables** panel header.
Select **Local** or **Global** at the top-left of the **Variable Manager** and click **Add New Variable**.
Check the **Panel** box to pin the variable to the sidebar, enter a **Variable Name**, and choose a **Type**.
For a **number**, **string**, or **boolean**, enter its starting value directly in **Value / Structure**.
For a **list** or **map**, click **Configure LIST** or **Configure MAP** to add nested items, or click the **Edit Raw JSON** icon in the header to paste a JSON array or object.
Click **Done & Close**, then drag the variable from the **Variables** panel onto the canvas while holding **Ctrl** (to spawn **Get Variable**) or **Alt** (to spawn **Set Variable**).

blocks.content: You can also bind a variable directly to an unconnected node input port in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) or manipulate collections with [Collections & Data](node_library/data_collections) nodes.

rows: Click the variable icon next to any input in **Parameters** to bind a variable directly and apply inline modifiers such as **Add (+)**, **Invert (NOT !)**, or **Random Item**.
Reads or writes a **Local** or **Global** variable in the graph.
Reads or updates an item at a specific zero-based index in a **List**.
Appends a new item to the end of a **List** or removes an item by index.
Reads or updates a value associated with a string key in a **Map**.
Reads or writes nested values inside a **List** or **Map** using a dot or bracket path such as **player.stats.hp** or **items[0].name**.

blocks.message: When you bind a **String** variable directly to a node input port, type text around **{value}** in the format box (for example, **Score: {value}**) to format the output string inline.

blocks.content: Create a global **Score** variable, add 10 points when an event triggers, and display the formatted score on a [Text Renderer](components/renderers/text_renderer).

items: Open the **Variable Manager**, switch to **Global**, and click **Add New Variable**.
Check **Panel**, name the variable **Score**, set **Type** to **number**, and set its value to **0**.
Hold **Alt** and drag **Score** from the **Variables** panel onto the canvas to create a **Set Score** node.
In the **Parameters** section of **Set Score**, click **Switch to Variable** next to **Value**, select **Score (Global)**, and apply the **Add (+)** modifier with a value of **10**.
Add a [Set Text](node_library/game_renderer#node-setText) node, connect **execOut** from **Set Score** to **execIn** on **Set Text**, and set **targetEntity** to your score label ID.
On the **Set Text** node, click **Switch to Variable** next to **text**, select **Score (Global)**, and enter **Score: {value}** in the format field.
